answer.answer:
### Chain map
| Chain step | Supported mapping |
|---|---|
| Automotive market requirement | In the downstream high-speed SerDes eco-chain, automotive ADAS and V2X communication require high-speed signal transmission [40]. |
| Technical test context | High-speed electrical-interface validation includes a transmission channel with Tx package, PCBs, connectors, and Rx package [24]. |
| Measurable parameter | The high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow lists IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram and TDR impedance as measured or analyzed items [22]. |
| PCB-test parameter set | R&S PCB test solutions list Material Measurement as impedance by TDR and DK/DF extraction, and list Material/Stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram [47]. |
| VNA capability needed for IL / transmission loss | For an R&S ZNA67 VNA, the base frequency range is 10 MHz to 67 GHz, with 2 or 4 ports, 50 Ω impedance, 1 Hz frequency resolution, 1 to 100001 measurement points per trace, and measurement bandwidth from 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz or 1 Hz to 30 MHz with R&S ZNA-K17 [76]. |
| VNA capability needed for transmission accuracy | R&S ZNA67 transmission uncertainty is specified across ranges up to >50 GHz to 67 GHz, including 0 dB to –30 dB transmission at 0.07 dB / 2.1° and –50 dB to –60 dB transmission at 0.47 dB / 4.3° in the >50 GHz to 67 GHz range [77]. |
| VNA capability needed for weak-loss / high-dynamic-range measurements | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB specification without options, 147 dB typical with options, and maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction [56]. |
| VNA capability needed for reflection / return-loss related work | R&S ZNA67 effective system data with R&S ZN-Z218 calibration kit includes directivity, source match, load match, reflection tracking, and transmission tracking up to 50 GHz to 67 GHz [78]. |
| Evidence gap | The R&S PCB test-solution source does not provide formal R&S product model, option code, test frequency, test standard, fixture, or calibration method for the PCB flow [48]. |
【推論】A defensible chain is: automotive ADAS/V2X needs high-speed signal transmission → the relevant channel includes PCBs and connectors → PCB/PCBA SI parameters include IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, and TDR impedance → a VNA used for this chain should cover the required frequency span, ports, dynamic range, transmission/reflection accuracy, and calibration conditions; the cited ZNA67 facts support those VNA capability dimensions but do not prove a formally specified automotive solution [40][24][22][47][76][77][78].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

Rohde & Schwarz verifies Next Generation eCall for EN 17240_2024 Standard › 重點摘要
- [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 宣稱其與 [[Qualcomm Technologies]] 合作，驗證 [[Snapdragon Auto 5G Modem-RF]] 上 [[Next Generation eCall]]（NG eCall）的 implementation，並稱其符合 [[EN 17240]]:2024。
- 來源說 [[eCall]] 於 2015 年導入，且自 2018 年起成為歐盟境內所有新車銷售的 mandatory requirement。
- 來源指出，隨著 2G / 3G circuit-switched cellular networks 逐漸 obsolete，emergency call systems 需要適配到 4G / 5G packet-switched cellular networks。

### Chain map
| Chain step | Supported mapping |
|---|---|
| Automotive market requirement | In the downstream high-speed SerDes eco-chain, automotive ADAS and V2X communication require high-speed signal transmission [40]. |
| Technical test context | High-speed electrical-interface validation includes a transmission channel with Tx package, PCBs, connectors, and Rx package [24]. |
| Measurable parameter | The high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow lists IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram and TDR impedance as measured or analyzed items [22]. |
| PCB-test parameter set | R&S PCB test solutions list Material Measurement as impedance by TDR and DK/DF extraction, and list Material/Stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram [47]. |
| VNA capability needed for IL / transmission loss | For an R&S ZNA67 VNA, the base frequency range is 10 MHz to 67 GHz, with 2 or 4 ports, 50 Ω impedance, 1 Hz frequency resolution, 1 to 100001 measurement points per trace, and measurement bandwidth from 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz or 1 Hz to 30 MHz with R&S ZNA-K17 [76]. |
| VNA capability needed for transmission accuracy | R&S ZNA67 transmission uncertainty is specified across ranges up to >50 GHz to 67 GHz, including 0 dB to –30 dB transmission at 0.07 dB / 2.1° and –50 dB to –60 dB transmission at 0.47 dB / 4.3° in the >50 GHz to 67 GHz range [77]. |
| VNA capability needed for weak-loss / high-dynamic-range measurements | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB specification without options, 147 dB typical with options, and maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction [56]. |
| VNA capability needed for reflection / return-loss related work | R&S ZNA67 effective system data with R&S ZN-Z218 calibration kit includes directivity, source match, load match, reflection tracking, and transmission tracking up to 50 GHz to 67 GHz [78]. |
| Evidence gap | The R&S PCB test-solution source does not provide formal R&S product model, option code, test frequency, test standard, fixture, or calibration method for the PCB flow [48]. |
【推論】A defensible chain is: automotive ADAS/V2X needs high-speed signal transmission → the relevant channel includes PCBs and connectors → PCB/PCBA SI parameters include IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, and TDR impedance → a VNA used for this chain should cover the required frequency span, ports, dynamic range, transmission/reflection accuracy, and calibration conditions; the cited ZNA67 facts support those VNA capability dimensions but do not prove a formally specified automotive solution [40][24][22][47][76][77][78].

ZNA_specs_en_5215-4652-22_v2400 › 規格條件與資料定義
- Specifications with limits：表示 warranted product performance；以 <、≤、>、≥、±、maximum、limit of、minimum 等符號標示；compliance 由 testing 確保或由 design 推導。
- Non-traceable specifications with limits（n. trc.）：依 specifications with limits 指定與測試，但因缺乏可追溯至 national metrology standards 的 measuring equipment，product performance 不保證。
- Specifications without limits：表示 warranted product performance；未特別標記時表示數值沒有或只有可忽略偏差。
- Typical data（typ.）：representative information；若標示 <、> 或 range，代表約 80% instruments 在 production time 可達成的 performance，其他情況代表 mean value。
- Nominal values（nom.）：representative value；production 期間不測試該 parameter。
- Measured values（meas.）：individual samples 的 measurement results。
- Uncertainties：coverage factor 2，依 Guide to the Expression of Uncertainty in Measurement（GUM），並考量 environmental conditions、aging、wear and tear。
- 來源明確說明：non-traceable specifications with limits、typical data、nominal values、measured values 不由 Rohde & Schwarz 保證。

- 來源稱 [[European Commission]] 在其 most recent regulation 中定義 NG eCall 將自 **2026-01-01** 起成為 obligatory。

- Press and media contact 為 [[Patrizia Muehlbauer]]，職稱 PR Manager Products & Standard Systems。
- 公司資訊段落稱 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 2024/2025 fiscal year net revenue 為 EUR 3.16 billion，2025-06-30 worldwide employees more than 15,000。

### Chain map
| Chain step | Supported mapping |
|---|---|
| Automotive market requirement | In the downstream high-speed SerDes eco-chain, automotive ADAS and V2X communication require high-speed signal transmission [40]. |
| Technical test context | High-speed electrical-interface validation includes a transmission channel with Tx package, PCBs, connectors, and Rx package [24]. |
| Measurable parameter | The high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow lists IL / Xtalk / Eye diagram and TDR impedance as measured or analyzed items [22]. |
| PCB-test parameter set | R&S PCB test solutions list Material Measurement as impedance by TDR and DK/DF extraction, and list Material/Stackup selection with IL, DK/DF, roughness, impedance, Xtalk, TL modeling, and Eye diagram [47]. |
| VNA capability needed for IL / transmission loss | For an R&S ZNA67 VNA, the base frequency range is 10 MHz to 67 GHz, with 2 or 4 ports, 50 Ω impedance, 1 Hz frequency resolution, 1 to 100001 measurement points per trace, and measurement bandwidth from 1 Hz to 1.5 MHz or 1 Hz to 30 MHz with R&S ZNA-K17 [76]. |
| VNA capability needed for transmission accuracy | R&S ZNA67 transmission uncertainty is specified across ranges up to >50 GHz to 67 GHz, including 0 dB to –30 dB transmission at 0.07 dB / 2.1° and –50 dB to –60 dB transmission at 0.47 dB / 4.3° in the >50 GHz to 67 GHz range [77]. |
| VNA capability needed for weak-loss / high-dynamic-range measurements | R&S ZNA key performance includes dynamic range >129 dB specification without options, 147 dB typical with options, and maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction [56]. |
| VNA capability needed for reflection / return-loss related work | R&S ZNA67 effective system data with R&S ZN-Z218 calibration kit includes directivity, source match, load match, reflection tracking, and transmission tracking up to 50 GHz to 67 GHz [78]. |
| Evidence gap | The R&S PCB test-solution source does not provide formal R&S product model, option code, test frequency, test standard, fixture, or calibration method for the PCB flow [48]. |
【推論】A defensible chain is: automotive ADAS/V2X needs high-speed signal transmission → the relevant channel includes PCBs and connectors → PCB/PCBA SI parameters include IL, Xtalk, Eye diagram, and TDR impedance → a VNA used for this chain should cover the required frequency span, ports, dynamic range, transmission/reflection accuracy, and calibration conditions; the cited ZNA67 facts support those VNA capability dimensions but do not prove a formally specified automotive solution [40][24][22][47][76][77][78].

- Dynamic range：> 129 dB specification without options；147 dB typical with options；maximum attainable range up to 170 dB allowing full 2-port correction。
- Sensitivity：> –120 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，specification without options；–162 dBm，1 Hz IF bandwidth，measured with options。來源註明 –162 dBm 是以 1 kHz measurement bandwidth 量測後 normalized to 1 Hz。

- Source power linearity：0.2 dB typical，範圍 –40 dBm to +10 dBm。
- Receiver compression：0.05 dB typical，up to +8 dBm at test port，referenced to –10 dBm。
- Trace noise：0.005 dB specification RMS、0.002 dB typical RMS，條件為 10 GHz、100 kHz measurement bandwidth、0 dB reflection。
